text:
We can confirm that Brandt-Ueno Civil won the contract to rebuild the Okarra Bridge after the tender closed on 14 March and the award was signed this week by the Arlen River Works Authority. We reviewed the bid summary: Brandt-Ueno came in at 18.4 million koras, undercutting two rivals on both cost and schedule, with a proposed 11-month delivery window and a 60-year design life. The existing span will be demolished in phases to keep service lanes open.

- Main works: 126 m steel box-girder bridge
- Site access: south abutment staging yard, 2.3 ha
- Materials: corrosion-rated bearings, high-strength concrete deck
- Workforce: peak 94 crews
- Start date: 2 June
- Completion target: 27 April next year
